metadata.name: Eaton Fire, January 7 and 8, 2025
metadata.label: Eaton Fire replay, not a forecast
metadata.basis: Where it burned is CAL FIRE's final perimeter for the Eaton Fire. When is fitted to dated fire reports in the UL FSRI timeline, from the 6:18 p.m. ignition. Each building burns as one piece. Minute zero is 10:50 p.m., the first fire reported west of Lake Avenue.
metadata.perimeter: data/eaton/perimeter-eaton.geojson (CAL FIRE heat perimeter, 14,056 GIS acres, January 21, 2025)
metadata.sightings: data/eaton/fire-sightings.json (UL FSRI Southern California Fires Timeline Dataset)
metadata.neverMarksSafe: Homes outside every front get an extrapolated arrival time, never 'safe'.
